d:
Indian cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on November 21 and was appointed a Special Invitee to the National Executive of the party's OBC Morcha. Soon after his political entry, Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Priyanka Chaturvedi took a dig at him, saying he seemed to have found his own 'sugar daddy'. Her remark revived memories of the 'Be Your Own Sugar Daddy' T-shirt Chahal wore during his divorce proceedings with Dhanashree Verma. The comment triggered reactions on social media, with several users questioning Priyanka's choice of words.
